description: Add per-connection monitoring to Agora Studio on top of the topology graph (61): health/status, uptime, and error surfaces for each MCP/A2A connection in the user's setup, read over the REAL direct links between participants (ADR-0001 — never relayed through Studio, which stays an observer). Reuse the console's existing link/transport primitives as the reference for probing real connections (`console/src/kcs/link.ts`, `http.ts`, `a2a-wire.ts`, `mcp-wire.ts`) rather than inventing a new client. Scope: the `studio/` workspace only. agora gates on `make check`.

userStories.title: Per-connection health/status over the real direct links
userStories.description: Compute a health/status for each edge by observing the actual MCP/A2A connection (reusing the console's link/transport primitives), never by proxying traffic through Studio.
acceptanceCriteria: Each graph edge carries a per-connection status (e.g. up / degraded / down) derived from observing the real direct MCP/A2A link — reusing the console's link/transport primitives (`console/src/kcs/link.ts`/`http.ts`/`a2a-wire.ts`/`mcp-wire.ts`) by reference, not a new relay

A test drives status computation from synthetic reachable and unreachable connections and asserts the correct per-edge status, with an unknown/unprobed connection reported as such rather than assumed healthy
`make check` green (`npm run lint` + `npm run typecheck` + `vitest` for `studio/`); Studio relays no traffic (ADR-0001)

userStories.title: Uptime and error surfaces in the UI
userStories.description: Surface each connection's uptime and its recent errors on the graph/backbone so a user can see what is failing and for how long.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI surfaces per-connection uptime and the most recent error(s) for each connection (selectable from the graph edge or a connections panel), reflecting the statuses from US-1 as they change

A rendering test (`*.test.tsx`) asserts a degraded/down connection shows its error surface and a healthy one shows its uptime; the panel is empty (not fabricated) when no connections are configured, consistent with the 60 empty backbone
`make check` green; Studio stays source-first and observer-only
